# CLAUDE.md — TheAtlas Queue Context
<!-- Auto-generated by dream bootstrap: 2026-05-24 -->

## Project Identity
Esports queue management dashboard for TheAtlas streaming — Next.js 16 + Shadcn 4 + @dnd-kit

## What This Project IS
- A Kick.com integrated queue manager with drag-and-drop reordering
- A moderation dashboard with warning/punishment/banned levels
- A randomization tool with fortune wheel and list-scroll animations
- A premium UI themed with the Caelestia Fidelity palette and Anthropic fonts

## What This Project IS NOT
- Not a game server or matchmaking backend
- Not a chat bot — it reads Kick chat for queue commands only
- Not a general-purpose streaming tool

## Critical Files
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/components/dashboard.tsx` | Main orchestrator (~860 lines) |
| `src/hooks/use-queue.ts` | Queue state, add/remove/pick/randomize logic |
| `src/hooks/use-settings.ts` | User settings persistence |
| `src/hooks/use-easter-eggs.ts` | Konami, Bad Apple, confetti triggers |
| `src/app/globals.css` | Caelestia palette, animations, glass utilities |
| `src/lib/auth.ts` | next-auth v5 config (Kick OAuth) |
| `src/lib/kick.ts` | Kick API integration |
| `.env.local` | Secrets (NEXTAUTH_SECRET, Kick OAuth, Riot API) |

## Rules
- Turkish UI labels, English code/comments
- All toasts gated by `settings.enableToasts`
- Use oklch color functions (not hex) for new color work
- Anthropic font family only — no Google Fonts

## Build
```bash
npm run dev    # dev server on :3000
npm run build  # production build
npm run lint   # eslint
```
